<!-- benchmark_somalier*.md is generated from this Rmd. Do not edit a rendered report. -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

This report measures DuckHTS's public Somalier-derived SQL stack on ordinary
Parquet relations: validated panel and population-frequency hashing, sketch
preparation, selected and all-pair relatedness reduction, CHARR, directional
matched-anchor contamination, and end-to-end output persistence. The fixture
has the canonical Somalier panel width of 17,000 biallelic sites, but its
coordinates, population B frequencies, and count evidence are deterministic
arithmetic data. They are not upstream Somalier sites, population estimates,
or biological observations, and this report makes no biological-parity claim.

The default workload is 250 samples and 4,250,000 count-evidence rows.
`SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SAMPLES` may select 2 through 1,000 samples without network
access. The default is the registry identity used for checked-in measurements;
an override is a parameterized cache instance of the same registry derivation.
`SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_SAMPLES` and `SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_PAIRS`
set distinct selected samples `K` and distinct ordered requested pairs `P`.
The default is `K=3, P=2` when at least three samples are staged. The first
`K-1` pairs form a receiver-to-sample001 star; additional pairs follow a
deterministic distinct ordered topology.

## Interface decision

The retained evidence is a long typed relation keyed by sample and panel site,
with nullable A/B/other counts. This keeps unavailable evidence distinct from
measured zero, lets `read_geno(format_fields := ['AD'])` supply header-typed
allele depths without serializing native structs, and permits Parquet projection
of only the identity and count columns. The nearest recorded AD-ingestion
measurement is `benchmark_genotype_format_review.md`: one projected sample over
4,048,342 GIAB records and 8,144,465 nonmissing AD values took a median 7.479 s;
the unprojected control took 5.847 s. That report also records zero differences
against projected `read_bcf()` for the selected fields.

Preparation returns one packed sketch row per sample; pairwise relatedness then
borrows two sketches. This avoids expanding every pair back to site rows and
avoids opaque `.somalier` payloads. Selected pairs are ordinary two-column
relations, so a new batch can join only new-to-cohort pairs while the all-pair
case remains available. Contamination keeps long count evidence because GT
masks cannot supply measured depths or population AF. The measurements below
separately exercise preparation, selected pairs, all pairs, contamination, and
Parquet-to-results execution; they do not benchmark BCF decoding or a specific
new-batch cohort ratio.

## Reproduction

Build the extension from the source revision under test, then render a named,
non-overwriting snapshot from the repository root. Set
`SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_EXTENSION_RECEIPT` to a verified release-extension receipt
whose source revision and extension SHA-256 match the checkout and measured
binary:

```{r clean-build, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
source("scripts/duckvep_evidence.R")
root <- normalizePath(".")
revision <- duckvep_evidence_revision(root)
extension <- duckvep_evidence_build_extension(root,
  "build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension", revision)
duckvep_evidence_write_extension_receipt(
  "/tmp/somalier-extension.tsv", revision, extension
)
```

```sh
BENCHMARK_RMD=benchmark_somalier.Rmd \
BENCHMARK_REPORT=benchmark_somalier_reviewed.md \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_EXTENSION_RECEIPT=/tmp/somalier-extension.tsv \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SAMPLES=250 \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_SAMPLES=3 \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_PAIRS=2 \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_THREADS=4 \
SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_REPETITIONS=3 \
make bench-snapshot
```

Rendering refuses tracked or untracked changes below `src/` and in the
benchmark source, runner, stage implementation, and registry. The report
requires a verified release build receipt binding that revision to the
measured extension SHA-256. Staging is local and deterministic under the recorded generator
and DuckDB writer version; it neither downloads data nor invokes an upstream tool.
Each measured repetition runs in a fresh R process. Extension load, connection
creation, input validation, and prerequisite construction for the two isolated
pair-reduction cases are outside those timed intervals. The end-to-end case
includes all public computations and ordered persistence of their five output
relations to ordinary Zstandard-compressed Parquet.
The `matched_memory` case captures Linux process high-water RSS immediately
before and after the matched public call, before whole-input validation and
the independent result oracle. A single `K/P` point is not a memory-scaling
proof.

```{r measurement, include=FALSE}
library(DBI)
source("r/duckhtsbench/R/registry.R")
source("r/duckhtsbench/R/stage.R")
source("r/duckhtsbench/R/somalier.R")
Sys.setenv(DUCKHTSBENCH_REGISTRY =
  normalizePath("r/duckhtsbench/inst/benchmark_registry.tsv", mustWork = TRUE))

benchmark_sources <- c("benchmarks/benchmark_somalier.Rmd",
  "benchmarks/benchmark_somalier_run.R", "r/duckhtsbench/R/registry.R",
  "r/duckhtsbench/R/stage.R", "r/duckhtsbench/R/somalier.R",
  "r/duckhtsbench/inst/benchmark_registry.tsv", "scripts/duckvep_evidence.R")
dirty <- system2("git", c("status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all", "--",
                         "src", benchmark_sources), stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE)
if (length(dirty)) stop("Render the Somalier benchmark from committed src/ and benchmark inputs")
source_revision <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE)
source_tree <- system2("git", c("rev-parse", "HEAD:src"), stdout = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(source_revision) == 1L, nchar(source_revision) == 40L,
          length(source_tree) == 1L, nchar(source_tree) == 40L)

whole_number <- function(name, default, minimum, maximum) {
  value <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Sys.getenv(name, unset = as.character(default))))
  if (length(value) != 1L || !is.finite(value) || value != floor(value) ||
      value < minimum || value > maximum) {
    stop(name, " must be a whole number from ", minimum, " through ", maximum)
  }
  as.integer(value)
}
samples <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SAMPLES", 250L, 2L, 1000L)
selected_samples <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_SAMPLES",
                                 min(samples, 3L), 2L, samples)
selected_pairs <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_SELECTED_PAIRS",
                               selected_samples - 1L, selected_samples - 1L,
                               min(selected_samples * (selected_samples - 1L), 100000L))
threads <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_THREADS", 4L, 1L, 256L)
repetitions <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_REPETITIONS", 3L, 1L, 20L)
warmups <- whole_number("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_WARMUPS", 1L, 0L, 5L)
extension <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv(
  "DUCKHTS_EXTENSION", "build/release/duckhts.duckdb_extension"), mustWork = TRUE)
paths <- duckhts_bench_stage_somalier(samples, selected_samples, selected_pairs)
input_bytes <- file.info(paths)$size
input_sha256 <- vapply(paths, digest::digest, character(1L), file = TRUE, algo = "sha256")
extension_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = extension, algo = "sha256")
benchmark_sha256 <- vapply(benchmark_sources, digest::digest, character(1L),
                          file = TRUE, algo = "sha256")
receipt_setting <- Sys.getenv("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_EXTENSION_RECEIPT", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(receipt_setting)) {
  stop("SOMALIER_BENCHMARK_EXTENSION_RECEIPT must name a verified release build receipt")
}
source("scripts/duckvep_evidence.R")
receipt_path <- normalizePath(receipt_setting, mustWork = TRUE)
build <- duckvep_evidence_read_extension_receipt(receipt_path, normalizePath("."),
                                                  extension, source_revision)
stopifnot(identical(build$sha256, extension_sha256))
binary_binding <- paste("verified release receipt:", build$binding)
receipt_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = receipt_path, algo = "sha256")

runner <- normalizePath("benchmarks/benchmark_somalier_run.R", mustWork = TRUE)
cases <- c("panel_hash", "sketches", "related_selected", "related_all", "charr",
           "matched_anchor", "matched_memory", "end_to_end")
run_case <- function(case, repetition, warmup = FALSE) {
  directory <- tempfile(sprintf("somalier-%s-%d-", case, repetition))
  result_path <- paste0(directory, ".tsv")
  log_path <- paste0(directory, ".log")
  dir.create(directory)
  on.exit(unlink(c(directory, result_path, log_path), recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  args <- c(runner, case, extension, unname(paths), directory, threads, result_path)
  status <- system2("Rscript", shQuote(args), stdout = log_path, stderr = log_path)
  if (status != 0L || !file.exists(result_path)) {
    stop("Somalier benchmark subprocess failed:\n",
         paste(readLines(log_path, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))
  }
  value <- utils::read.delim(result_path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(nrow(value) == 1L, identical(value$case, case))
  value$repetition <- repetition
  value$warmup <- warmup
  value
}
if (warmups) {
  for (warmup in seq_len(warmups)) {
    for (case in cases) invisible(run_case(case, warmup, TRUE))
  }
}
measurements <- list()
for (repetition in seq_len(repetitions)) {
  order <- if (repetition %% 2L) cases else rev(cases)
  for (case in order) {
    measurements[[length(measurements) + 1L]] <- run_case(case, repetition)
  }
}
measurements <- do.call(rbind, measurements)
rownames(measurements) <- NULL
for (rows in split(measurements, measurements$case)) {
  stopifnot(length(unique(rows$fingerprint)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$sites)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$samples)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$evidence_rows)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$selected_samples)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$selected_pairs)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$result_rows)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$persisted_output_rows)) == 1L,
            length(unique(rows$persisted_output_bytes)) == 1L,
            all(vapply(rows[grepl("_output_(rows|bytes)$", names(rows))],
                       function(value) length(unique(value)) == 1L, logical(1L))))
}
summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cases, function(case) {
  rows <- measurements[measurements$case == case, , drop = FALSE]
  data.frame(
    workload = case,
    median_seconds = stats::median(rows$seconds),
    repetitions = nrow(rows),
    result_rows = rows$result_rows[[1L]],
    persisted_output_rows = rows$persisted_output_rows[[1L]],
    persisted_output_bytes = rows$persisted_output_bytes[[1L]],
    median_process_peak_rss_kib = stats::median(rows$peak_process_rss_kib, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_peak_increase_kib = stats::median(rows$peak_increase_kib, na.rm = TRUE),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
work <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cases, function(case) {
  row <- measurements[measurements$case == case, , drop = FALSE][1L, ]
  row[c("case", "related_selected_pairs", "related_all_pairs",
        "related_selected_joint_sites", "related_all_joint_sites", "charr_samples",
        "charr_usable_sites", "matched_pairs", "matched_profile_samples",
        "matched_profile_input_rows", "matched_profile_elements",
        "matched_profile_payload_bytes",
        "frequency_profile_elements", "frequency_profile_payload_bytes",
        "matched_usable_sites", "matched_evaluations", "matched_panel_site_visits",
        "matched_likelihood_contributions")]
}))
related_work <- work[work$related_selected_pairs + work$related_all_pairs > 0,
  c("case", "related_selected_pairs", "related_all_pairs",
    "related_selected_joint_sites", "related_all_joint_sites"), drop = FALSE]
charr_work <- work[work$charr_samples > 0,
  c("case", "charr_samples", "charr_usable_sites"), drop = FALSE]
matched_work <- work[work$matched_pairs > 0,
  c("case", "matched_pairs", "matched_profile_samples",
    "matched_profile_input_rows", "matched_profile_elements",
    "matched_profile_payload_bytes", "frequency_profile_elements",
    "frequency_profile_payload_bytes", "matched_usable_sites",
    "matched_evaluations", "matched_panel_site_visits",
    "matched_likelihood_contributions"), drop = FALSE]
input_summary <- data.frame(
  artifact = names(paths),
  rows = c(17000, 17000, 17000 * samples, selected_pairs),
  bytes = unname(input_bytes),
  sha256 = unname(input_sha256),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
end_to_end <- measurements[measurements$case == "end_to_end", , drop = FALSE][1L, ]
output_summary <- data.frame(
  relation = c("sketches", "selected relatedness", "all-pair relatedness", "CHARR",
               "directional matched-anchor"),
  rows = unname(as.numeric(end_to_end[1L, c("sketches_output_rows", "selected_output_rows",
    "all_pairs_output_rows", "charr_output_rows", "matched_output_rows")])),
  bytes = unname(as.numeric(end_to_end[1L, c("sketches_output_bytes", "selected_output_bytes",
    "all_pairs_output_bytes", "charr_output_bytes", "matched_output_bytes")])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
provenance <- data.frame(
  item = c("checkout revision", "checkout src/ tree", "binary/checkout binding",
           "extension SHA-256", "extension path", "build receipt path",
           "build receipt SHA-256", "samples", "panel sites",
           "count-evidence rows", "measured evidence rows", "unavailable evidence rows",
           "selected samples K", "requested ordered pairs P", "threads",
           "timed repetitions", "excluded warmups", "R", "DuckDB R package", "host"),
  value = c(source_revision, source_tree, binary_binding,
            extension_sha256, extension, receipt_path, receipt_sha256, samples, 17000,
            17000 * samples, measurements$measured_evidence_rows[[1L]],
            measurements$unavailable_evidence_rows[[1L]], selected_samples, selected_pairs,
            threads, repetitions, warmups,
            R.version.string, as.character(utils::packageVersion("duckdb")),
            paste(Sys.info()[c("sysname", "release", "machine")], collapse = " ")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
benchmark_identity <- data.frame(source = benchmark_sources,
                                 sha256 = unname(benchmark_sha256),
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
memory_repetitions <- measurements[measurements$case == "matched_memory",
  c("repetition", "seconds", "baseline_peak_rss_kib", "measured_peak_rss_kib",
    "peak_increase_kib"), drop = FALSE]
```

## Provenance and exact inputs

```{r provenance}
knitr::kable(provenance)
knitr::kable(benchmark_identity)
knitr::kable(input_summary)
```

Every evidence row retains the ordered panel identity, sample ID, and nullable
integer A/B/other counts. Independent pre-timing checks require one dense
17,000-site panel, one AF row per site, one evidence row per sample/site, and
either three measured counts or three NULL counts. Every synthetic panel site
has lexicographically canonical `allele_a < allele_b`. The pair relation
contains `P` distinct ordered requests spanning `K` selected sample IDs.

## Measurements

```{r results}
knitr::kable(summary, digits = 3)
knitr::kable(related_work)
knitr::kable(charr_work)
knitr::kable(matched_work)
knitr::kable(output_summary)
knitr::kable(memory_repetitions, digits = 3)
```

The runner checks 266 words in each of the three prepared masks. Selected-pair
`jointly_called`, `ibs0`, and `ibs2` integers are compared with a separate SQL
classification over raw counts. All-pair reduction must emit exactly the
sample-sketch self-join's pair keys, checked by a full outer join, with
`samples * (samples - 1) / 2` unique pairs and nonzero evaluated sites. CHARR
must retain every sample, input site, and unavailable-count denominator. A
separate SQL calculation checks every sample's usable counters and estimate;
the retained sample001 estimate is also checked against an arithmetic R
expectation. Directional matched-anchor output must retain every requested
ordered pair and 17,000 observed sites per pair. A separate raw-count SQL
calculation checks usable and unavailable sites for every requested pair.
The retained sample002-to-sample001 and, when present,
sample003-to-sample001 alpha and relative log likelihood are checked by a
separate vectorized R likelihood and optimizer. Finally,
every persisted Parquet relation is
rescanned and checked against its exact expected row count. These gates run
outside the displayed elapsed intervals and prevent a fast result obtained by
dropped samples, sites, pairs, or outputs.

`median_process_peak_rss_kib` is Linux `VmHWM` for each fresh benchmark process.
For ordinary cases it includes untimed R, DuckDB, extension load, validation,
and correctness state. In `matched_memory`, the reported high-water mark and
increase are captured directly after the public matched call and before
whole-input checks or the independent oracle. The increase is a difference
between two process high-water marks, not an allocation counter; reused
previously committed memory may not increase it. It is `NA` on systems without
`/proc/self/status`. The current report is one `K/P` topology and makes no
sample-vs-pair memory-growth claim. The matched implementation prepares four
typed lists per selected sample (`K * 17,000 * 4` list elements, with 10 typed
payload bytes per site, read from `K * 17,000` evidence rows) and one eight-byte
AF list per site; it then evaluates
`P` scalar fits. `result_rows` counts actual computation rows for every lane.
Persisted output rows and bytes are nonzero only for end-to-end persistence.
